structured_output.title: Trim the render seam, allocation-free car pose, fix stale comments
structured_output.summary: Removes the render barrel's re-exports that nothing imports through it, and drops `export` from five render symbols that are only used inside their own files. Changes `groundUnderBody` and `visualPose` in src/sim/car.ts to write into module scratch instead of allocating arrays and objects for every car on every tick. Fixes three stale comments (scene graph, grid slots, finish panel). All of this is export-list, comment or allocation-only: the same floats are computed in the same order, no RNG or constants move, no CSS or DOM changes, and every name that tests, gates or harness/screens import is kept.

chosen.why: Checked: in render/index.ts, frameWidthFor, CameraRig, CarObject, DustPool, LIGHT_DIRECTION, TOON_STEPS, Materials and all of line 9 have no importer through the barrel. A grep of tests/, harness/, guardrails/ and spikes/ finds none. Delete line 9, remove the other names, and update the line 1–2 comment. This is a superset of C006. Keep everything else, including countdownOffsetEast (tests/render/countdown-*.test.ts import it, though C024's keep list leaves it out) and createRaceScene, buildCar, createMaterials and playerLivery. Net negative lines.

Apply after C024 so that attachOutline's barrel re-export is already gone. Drop `export` from smoothNormals (geometry.ts:162), CREASE_ANGLE_DEG and attachOutline (outline.ts:19,84), and OUTLINE_PX_AT_844 and MaterialKind (materials/index.ts:36,20). Grep confirms there is no importer outside each file anywhere in the repo. Keyword-only change with no runtime effect. It completes tonight's narrowing of the render surface.

Performance item. groundUnderBody (car.ts:193-208) allocates ts, a ts.map array and a closure, and visualPose returns a new {y,pitch}, for every car on every tick (perf.json: about 1.2–1.9 KB/frame). Use module scratch next to `ground` (bodyTs/bodyHs reset with length=0, and a pose object that carView reads at once). Push -half, 0, half, then lips and feet in the same order, and fill hs with a plain loop calling the same groundAt. Same maths in the same order, display-only, so replays and bot laps stay bit-identical. Small growth, allowed for performance.

Real: scene.ts:12 says each car Group holds 'body mesh + player ▼ marker', but car.ts:191-193 also adds the 'car-roundel' mesh. This is the scene-graph map that render tests and feature nights rely on. Comment-only fix: 'body mesh, roof roundel + player ▼ marker'.

Real: world.ts:46 says only six-car races reach slots from GRID_CURVED_FROM (=4) on, but i=4 is used by any race of five or more cars (createWorld accepts any positive carCount). Comment-only fix: '(races of five or more cars reach them)'. No code or constants change.

Real: game.ts:178 says 'the panel takes over the controls', but since B02 the results screen does, and finish-panel.ts is dead (C012). A one-word comment fix so the next feature night isn't sent to the dead module. Inside tick() and away from the start-screen code that B08 (#30) reshapes, so a conflict is unlikely and trivial.

rejected.reason: Subsumed by C024 (chosen), which removes the same seven names plus the other unused barrel re-exports.

Real duplication. But touch-controls.css is very likely edited by in-flight B09 (#31: touch slots slide in on race reset), and components.css may be too. Moving .ui-tc declarations across files while that PR is open invites a cascade-order conflict. Do it after #31 lands.

Incomplete: it misses a ninth deep import (src/ui/countdown.ts:5). It is net-zero import-path churn across 9 files, several of them (race-ui.ts, countdown.ts, results-screen.ts) likely touched by in-flight B08/B09. Better done once #30/#31 land.

The race-ui line it targets is already fixed in CLAUDE.md. The rest rewrites the owner's stated conventions (what registers by folder, the planned cars/features layout). That is the owner's call, not an unattended refactor's.

Touches game.ts draw(), which in-flight B08 (#30) changes. Caching one RaceView across frames also changes object identity for ui.sync, while B09 (#31) adds position and lap change detection in the UI that may keep or compare views. Re-check after both land.

Real rule violation (raw 844/390 in src/render). But reading the token needs new imports and a constant in three files, so src/ grows a few lines for a non-performance item, against tonight's delete-only rule. Pair it with a render feature night.
Duplicate of C031 (same 844×390 literals in the same three files). Rejected for the same net-growth reason.
Still adds a helper and an import to src/sim to replace five one-line expressions on hot sim paths. src/ grows for no performance gain, which the delete-only rule doesn't allow.
The local helper adds about as many lines as it removes at two call sites. Cosmetic churn.
Types-only alias move: one export plus three imports to delete two local aliases. Net growth for no behaviour or safety gain.
Types-only spelling change with zero net lines. Cosmetic churn.
Groups results-screen stripe rules into screens.css, coupling two stylesheets for a few lines. screens.css is likely reshaped by in-flight B08 (#30, the S6 stripe screen change). Low value now.
Needs a new exported helper plus edits to game.ts, race-ui.ts and the stage fixture, all likely in in-flight B08/B09. Net lines about zero. Wait until #30/#31 land.

Claim is wrong: CAR_LENGTH is imported through the barrel by src/render/car.ts:11. The sim barrel is also the documented sole entry for other layers. Trimming the RNG and replay API would push the next feature (e.g. B12 pickups) into deep imports, against C023's goal.

Moving msToTicks to format.ts needs a new import in countdown.ts (net about +1 line). It edits race-ui.ts and countdown.ts, which in-flight B09 (HUD event motion, #31) very likely changes along with their tick timings. Revisit after #31.
hud.css is certainly edited by in-flight B09 (#31: Pos/Lap stamps, slide-in entry). Regrouping the BEST/NEW BEST chip rules now risks a cascade conflict. Do it after #31 lands.
Real, but in-flight B08 (#30) rewrites the start screen and its CSS (screens.css, shared components), which would make these comments stale again or conflict. Fix them after #30 lands.

Swapping the CarView buffers changes object identity for everything that reads r.curr/r.prev (render mocks in game tests, ui.sync, state()). It also edits game.ts, which in-flight B08 (#30) touches. Too risky to promise unchanged behaviour unattended tonight; re-check after #30.

playtest.whatYoullSee: Nothing should look or feel different. Tonight only trims unused exports, changes how the car's display height and tilt are computed internally (same numbers, fewer allocations), and fixes comments. Cars, ramps, jumps, HUD and menus should look and behave exactly as yesterday.
howToTest: Race Dust Bowl and drive over the ramps: the car body tilts up the slope, flies, and lands level as before, with no jitter or snapping.
Race Hay Loop and take the back-straight ramp at full speed and at a crawl: the body rolls off the lip smoothly as before.
Start a six-car race: all six cars sit on the grid as before (the two rear slots follow the curve behind the line).
Bump a hay bale or tyre stack and nudge another car: cars still sit level on the ground with no sinking or floating.
Finish a race: the results screen appears and RETRY / NEXT RACE work as before.
